predecessors.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
predecessors.text: the whole country: 'officially the Democratic Republic of the Congo from 1965 to 1971 and the Republic of Zaire from 1971 to 1997'

successors.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
successors.text: the whole country: 'On 21 May, Kabila officially reverted the name of the country to the Democratic Republic of the Congo'

ledger.x: 27 October 1971: Mobutu renames the country the Republic of Zaire.
8 March 1977: Katangan rebels cross from Angola in the Shaba I invasion.
26 May 1977: the Shaba I invasion ends in Zairian victory.
May 1978: the Shaba II invasion and the Battle of Kolwezi.
May 1978: the Battle of Kolwezi is over within the month.
1996: the AFDL rebellion begins in eastern Zaire.
ledger.cp: Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo (AFDL)

ledger.x: 17-21 May 1997: the AFDL takes the country and Mobutu falls.
ledger.cp: Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation of Congo (AFDL)

ledger.x: 21 May 1997: Zaire ends and the Democratic Republic of the Congo returns.

wars.name: Shaba I
wars.outcome: Zairian victory, FNLC expelled from Shaba (infobox): Moroccan troops were airlifted to Kolwezi on French transport from 9 April, the allies recaptured Mutshatsha on 25 April and the war was over by 26 May 1977.

wars.name: Shaba II
wars.outcome: The pages opened give no result and no day: the Zaire page says only that 'the Battle of Kolwezi' was fought in May 1978 and that the invasion came from Angola.

wars.name: First Congo War
wars.outcome: AFDL victory: Mobutu fled into exile on 17 May 1997, the AFDL entered Kinshasa three days later and Kabila renamed the country the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 21 May.

certainty.note: Judgement, not read in the pages opened: the frontiers are the colonial-era treaty lines inherited at independence; the eastern frontier was not fought over by the pages' account.
